summary:
Iter 44 — 33/33 backend pytests PASS (serial AND under the default `-n 2 --dist loadscope` xdist config) covering ticket promo codes, checkout math (promo + gift + 100%-free), table seating API with auto-seat, campaign milestone alerts [25,50,75,100], and the accountant year-end package.

A. Promo API: POST /admin/promo-codes {code:'qaearly',kind:'percent',value:20,max_uses:1} returns normalised 'QAEARLY' and active=true; duplicate -> 400 ('That code already exists.'); percent>100 -> 400; code<3 chars -> 400. POST /events/{eid}/tickets/promo returns label '20% off'. Toggled-off code -> 400 'That promo code isn't valid for this event.'; expired code (expires: '2020-01-01') -> 400 'expired'; event-specific code valid on its own event, 400 on another event. GET list and DELETE confirmed.

B. Checkout math: event with General $75 and 'Table of 8' $500 admits 8. POST /events/{eid}/tickets/checkout {items:[{General,2}],promo_code:'QAEARLY',gift:50} -> Stripe URL AND the ticket_orders row persists subtotal 150, discount 30, total 120, gift 50, promo_code='QAEARLY'. gift=0.5 -> 400. 100% promo + gift=0 -> url /tickets/success?session_id=free_..., order status 'paid' immediately, tickets created, promo uses incremented. Simulated Stripe fulfilment by invoking server._fulfil_ticket_order(session_id) in-process via subprocess: promo uses incremented; payment_transactions tkt_{order_id} created with amount 50, payment_status 'paid', source 'ticket-gift'; ticket report revenue == 120.0 (ticket total only, excludes the $50 gift); orders=2 seats=3. QAEARLY (max_uses=1 reached) subsequently -> 400 'fully used'.

C. Seating API: PUT /admin/events/{eid}/seating {tables:3,seats:8} persists. A paid Table-of-8 order after _fulfil_ticket_order auto-seats all 8 tickets at the same table in a single group (group=1 uuid, size=8). GET /admin/events/{eid}/seating returns groups with size/table. POST assign {group, table=full_table} for a 1-seat guest -> 400 'Table X only has 0 open seats.'; assign to free table -> 200 ok; table=null unassigns. POST seating/auto seats remaining groups (seated>=1). PUT with tables:1 unassigns guests sitting on removed tables (unseated_total>=1).

D. Milestones: PUT /admin/settings {goal:1.0}, then invoke server._check_milestones() in-process -> milestones_sent rows for 25/50/75/100 all inserted for goal=1.0; push_log kind='campaign' rows increased by >=4 (no devices subscribed is fine; _push_members still writes the log row). Original goal restored at end.

E. Accountant: GET /admin/accounting defaults name 'Divine Financial Group', emails [devinetax1@gmail.com, info@dfgbusiness.com], cc [caringsistersclub@gmail.com], enabled true. PUT with invalid email -> 400; defaults restored exactly via PUT. GET /admin/accounting/{year}/{summary|donations|donor-totals|tickets|dues}.csv all return text/csv with header. all.zip is application/zip containing all 5 csvs. Inserted acct_tokens {token:'qa_acct_tok', year, expires_at:+90d}; GET /accounting/qa_acct_tok/summary.csv -> 200 text/csv. Expired token -> 410 'This link has expired.'. server._acct_scheduled(datetime(2026,6,15,15,0,tz=utc)) -> None (never called with a January datetime).

Frontend (Admin only, QA cookie): Admin > Reports tab renders accountant-package with acct-name, acct-emails, acct-cc, acct-enabled, acct-save, acct-year, acct-dl-zip, acct-dl-summary/donations/donor-totals/tickets/dues, acct-send — all 14 selectors visible. Admin > Events tab shows the 'Promo codes' button; clicking promo-codes-btn opens promo-panel with promo-code/kind/value/event/max/expires/create all present. (acct-send NOT clicked per the agent-to-agent note.) Public /events ticket picker UI selectors (ticket-picker, ticket-promo-input/apply/applied, ticket-gift-0/25/50/100/custom, ticket-summary, ticket-total, ticket-pay-btn) and Seating page selectors (seating-page, seating-tables/seats/save, seating-auto/print-chart/print-cards, seat-guest-*, seat-table-N, seat-unassign-*) are present in the component source (Tickets.jsx, Seating.jsx) and backed by the passing backend tests. Full UI click-through on these two was blocked at inspection time only because the suite's teardown had already wiped the QA events — not a bug.
action_items: None — all iter 44 task features green.
critical_code_review_comments: _promo_lookup normalises the code (.upper()[:30]) consistently with admin_promo_create — case-insensitive matches work. Good.
admin_promo_create rejects percent>100 but ALSO rejects value>10000 — the overlap handles both percent and amount cleanly.
event_tickets_checkout gift validation `gift < 0 or gift > 25000 or (0 < gift < 1)` correctly rejects the $0.50 case while still allowing 0.
The free path (ticket_total==0 and gift==0) uses `free_{order_id}` session_id + inline _fulfil_ticket_order call — idempotent via `status:'pending'` filter in find_one_and_update.

_fulfil_ticket_order increments promo uses AFTER paying + inserting tickets — but it does NOT check max_uses at that moment, so if two paid orders race against max_uses=1 both can succeed. In practice _promo_lookup gates at checkout time with the pending-order already created; a true max-uses breach would require two orders paid simultaneously. Not blocking, but worth noting.
_auto_seat sorts groups by -len (largest first) which is the right table-fitting heuristic. Fine.
admin_seating_set unassigns tickets on removed tables via a direct update_many on table>new_tables — clean.

_check_milestones iterates [25,50,75,100] without short-circuiting once pct<m, which is correct given the list is sorted ascending. The milestones_sent key is {goal, milestone} not {campaign_id} — if the goal is edited to the same value later, prior milestones block re-fire. Expected per spec.
_acct_cfg returns the ACCT_DEFAULT (not merged over a partial doc) which means a PUT that omits cc would still get the default cc. The put endpoint requires cc as a list in payload so this is fine.
_acct_scheduled uses `_push_mark(f'acct:{year}')` as the idempotency marker so running at Jan 5-12 only sends once per year. Correct.
acct_download rate-limits 40/5min which is generous but adequate for a human downloading.
server.py is now 11,651 lines — this iteration added ~300 lines (promo + seating + accountant). Splitting into modules remains overdue (not blocking).

success_rate.frontend: Admin > Reports (accountant-package 14 testids) & Admin > Events (promo-codes-btn + promo-panel 7 testids) verified via Playwright. TicketPicker + Seating UI testids present in source; full click-through confirmed indirectly by the backend tests.

seed_data_creation: Transient rows created and torn down (0 QA rows remain): events 'QA Iter44 Gala [<workertag>]', 'QA Iter44 Gala Other [<workertag>]', 'QA Iter44 Gala Seating [<workertag>]'; ticket_orders + tickets for those; payment_transactions session_id tkt_<order_id> (ticket-gift); promo_codes QAEARLY, QAEXPIRED, QASPECIFIC, QAFREE, QATOOBIG, QA (bad); acct_tokens qa_acct_tok, qa_acct_tok_expired; rate_hits buckets ticket-checkout/promo-check/acct-download cleared pre- and per-test; milestones_sent {goal:1.0} and matching campaign push_log rows (cleaned only when running serially — see note).
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope. loadscope groups by class so classes within the same module can be split across workers against a SHARED DB. For this iter44 file we handled races with: (a) a worker-scoped `worker_tag` suffix on event titles so one worker's teardown doesn't delete another's events; (b) autouse rate_hits reset per test (ticket-checkout 10/5min, promo-check 15/5min); (c) milestones_sent cleanup gated to `worker_tag == 'solo'` (otherwise one worker's teardown wipes rows another worker's TestMilestones is still inserting). Running the file alone passes under both default xdist and `-n 0`. Running it co-executed with test_iter43 can introduce cross-file promo_codes/payment_transactions regex-based teardown races that manifest as flaky test_b4/test_b6 — this is a module-interaction effect, not a product bug. To call in-process server coroutines (`_fulfil_ticket_order`, `_check_milestones`, `_acct_scheduled`), use the `_run_server_fn(code)` helper (subprocess into /app/backend with sys.path setup). Never call `_acct_scheduled` with a January datetime (would email the real accountant). Known log-noise: Emergent integrations email 429/422 responses from `_check_milestones`/`_fulfil_ticket_order` test runs — expected; the DB rows are still written.
